mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthened economic demand, positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or quarterly GDPC1 growth fails to explain > 30% of SPX return variance over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce consumer and business spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4.5%) creates a synergistic effect, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the robust economy.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 0.5% in 1 month & UNRATE < 4.5%
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE explains < 20% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window, or SPX returns are not significantly higher in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, signaling increased industrial production, is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate improved corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of months with positive INDPRO growth, or monthly INDPRO growth fails to explain > 25% of SPX return variance over any 4-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in retail sales, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low FEDFUNDS rate (< 2%) and a high CPIAUCSL (> 250) creates an environment where S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be negative over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated inflationary pressures and monetary policy adjustments.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL explains < 30% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window, or SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in UNRATE (by > 0.8pp) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors interpret the drop as a sign of a strengthening labor market and economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increased HOUST (by > 5% in 2 months) and high GDPC1 (> $19.5 trillion) suggests a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by > 5% in 2 months & GDPC1 > $19.5 trillion
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and GDPC1 explains < 35% of SPX return variance over any 4-year window, or SPX returns are not significantly higher in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.12).
